function.arguments: {"observation": "The `arm` (treatment vs control) and `severity` (mild/moderate/severe) distributions are highly imbalanced. This suggests that clinicians assigned the treatment preferentially to sicker patients, violating the assumption of comparability between arms.", "implication": "A raw comparison of response rates between treatment and control arms would be confounded by baseline severity.
